chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Camp Nou, January 1994. Barcelona against Real Madrid. Romário waits at the edge of the box, a defender on his back. Guardiola passes... one swish of the foot, a toe-poke... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. He drags the ball round the defender without it leaving his foot. The Spanish call it the cow's tail.

chapters.label: The toe-poke
chapters.text: No big backswing: a quick toe-poke into the corner, before keeper Buyo is set. Barcelona won five-nil!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: in the box, a small feint buys you the space to shoot. Then shoot quickly!
